summary: Wrote a 5-phase implementation plan for the prune_next_body() flag misparse. Phases 1-2 fix the flag-segment separation in prune_next_body() and count_pruned_next_ids() inside agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/roadmap-integration.sh, anchoring segmentation on the first whitespace-preceded '-' rather than the first whitespace run (correcting a research recommendation that would mis-split the grammar-legal '716, 714 --hard'), plus a fail-safe passthrough for unclassifiable id tokens. Phase 3 adds seven flag-bearing --prune cases to each of the classic and stage test groups with exact-output assertions; Phase 4 extends roadmap-format.md's Next Grammar to admit the flag segment; Phase 5 redeploys and runs the full gate set. covered_ids_from()'s digit-scraping defect is recorded as an explicit Non-Goal.

artifacts.summary: 5-phase plan: fix both functions, add flag-bearing --prune coverage in both layouts, extend the Next Grammar, redeploy under the full gate set.
